hypotheses.title: Analyst Standardized Earnings Surprise (SUE) Drift
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Captures Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD). When quarterly actual EPS exceeds the consensus forecast mean, stock prices adjust gradually due to institutional conservatism and investor underreaction. Normalizing by close price ensures cross-sectional comparability, while a 60-day backfill captures the full quarterly drift cycle.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha breaks down if returns fail to persist beyond 5 days post-announcement or if surprise drift reverses within the same quarter.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative standardized earnings surprise with 60-day quarterly backfill

hypotheses.title: Customer Return Momentum Spillover across Supply Chain
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits information propagation delays across customer-supplier networks. Investors trade customers first upon positive demand shocks, but lag in adjusting supplier valuations. Aggregating 10 days of positive customer return signals creates a robust leading indicator for supplier performance.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if customer momentum does not lead supplier returns or if downstream shocks are absorbed by pricing power imbalances.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-neutralized cumulative customer return momentum with 5-day backfill

hypotheses.title: Volatility Term Structure Panic Mean Reversion
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits term-structure slope distortions during liquidity and hedging crunches. Normal volatility curves slope upwards (contango). When short-term 20-day volatility spikes above the 180-day baseline due to localized panic, the curve inverts. Inverting this ratio within subindustries captures the systematic mean-reversion as liquidity returns.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails if high short-term volatility reflects permanent solvency distress rather than transitory liquidity-driven overreaction.

candidates.rationale: Subindustry-relative inverted 20d/180d volatility ratio with 20-day backfill
